contestants.name: You
contestants.motive: Choose who to trust, survive the vote, and build a game you can explain.

contestants.name: Dan Gheesling
contestants.motive: Get people to carry his game for him, and make each of them believe it was their idea.
contestants.bio: Two-time finalist and mastermind of the legendary "Dan's Funeral." Manipulates through loyalty and calculated betrayals that leave houseguests stunned.

contestants.name: Dr. Will Kirby
contestants.motive: Tell everyone the truth about lying to them, and watch them keep him anyway.
contestants.bio: The original puppet master who won without winning a single competition. His charm and deception are unmatched in Big Brother history.

contestants.name: Derrick Levasseur
contestants.motive: Never let the house see the version of him that is actually running the season.
contestants.bio: Undercover cop who controlled the entire house without ever being nominated. His analytical mind dissects every social dynamic.

contestants.name: Janelle Pierzina
contestants.motive: Take safety off the board by winning it, every week, until nobody can afford her.
contestants.bio: Four-time player and undisputed competition queen. Her fierce loyalty and athletic dominance make her the ultimate competitor.

contestants.name: Cody Calafiore
contestants.motive: Find one person worth trusting completely, and win everything standing beside them.
contestants.bio: Returned to dominate All-Stars with a perfect game. His unwavering loyalty and competitive fire make him a dual threat.

contestants.name: Danielle Reyes
contestants.motive: Read the room better than anyone in it, and keep every reading to herself.
contestants.bio: Pioneer strategist who reached the final two in her first season and came back for All-Stars. Her intuitive reads on people are legendary.

contestants.name: Vanessa Rousso
contestants.motive: Work out everyone's odds out loud, then bet against the version they showed her.
contestants.bio: Poker pro who brought game theory to Big Brother. Emotional on the surface but calculating every probability underneath.

contestants.name: Tyler Crispen
contestants.motive: Look like the least dangerous person here for as long as that stays useful.
contestants.bio: Laid-back surfer who charmed his way through the house while running multiple alliances simultaneously. Never looks like a threat.

contestants.name: Chelsie Baham
contestants.motive: Be trusted by every side of the house, and pick which side finds out last.
contestants.bio: Quiet force who built deep connections and struck at exactly the right moments. Her social awareness flies under every radar.

contestants.name: Rachel Reilly
contestants.motive: Take every shot in front of her, loudly, and make the house deal with the noise.
contestants.bio: Brash, confrontational, and fiercely competitive. Came back for a second season and won it.

contestants.name: Xavier Prather
contestants.motive: Hold one alliance together all the way to the end without ever raising his voice.
contestants.bio: Cool and collected strategist who led the historic Cookout alliance to victory. Balances fierce loyalty with ruthless gameplay.
